purpose: Paired genuine Bazel 9.3.0 vs native bazel-rs capture of N23g (docs/TEST_COMMAND.md): bazel test (TestRunnerAction/StandaloneTestStrategy with genuine test-setup.sh and generate-xml.sh), environment, testlogs, test.xml/test.log bytes, summaries, exit codes, caching, sharding, flaky attempts, timeouts, test_suite expansion, filters and run of a test target. Fixture: tests/bazel_test.rs with tests/fixtures/test_flags/stubs. Evidence only; not an input of any test.

reference.flags: --registry=file://<private copy of tests/fixtures/builtin_modules/registry> --incompatible_autoload_externally= --lockfile_mode=off --noshow_progress --color=no --curses=no --repository_cache=<private> --distdir=<seeded from verified local CAS>
reference.env: env -i PATH=/usr/bin:/bin LANG=C.UTF-8 LC_ALL=C.UTF-8 INHERIT_ME=inherited FLAKY_MARKER=<private>, private HOME/TMPDIR, umask 022

harness_adjustments: run 2 (the one allowed rerun): normalization of the per-engine scratch directory and of testlogs below the run-of-test execution root (run 1 M34 differed only there); EXACT_MESSAGE accepts reference ERROR messages without their prefix (native prints bazel-rs: and exits 1 for option errors); M36 gains --keep_going (run 1: --nokeep_going aborted a timing-dependent set of tests on the sharding error).

native_fixes_between_runs: test.log of a test with failed attempts stays 0644 and attempt logs are 0555 (M6, M10)
--nokeep_going: a test action error stops tests not started yet (M36); --keep_going/-k for test
only the last key of a test action output is reusable from the cache, like the action cache (M37)
a build failure prints FAILED TO BUILD/NO STATUS summaries with exit 1 (M38)
the final build error is printed once (M8)
